verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals documents multi-platform notifications, and its pricing page lists push and email among the delivery channels. That covers two of the four channels the story names. There is no evidence of SMS or phone-call paging, or of user-configurable per-channel notification rules. Missing for 10: SMS delivery, phone/voice call delivery, per-channel personal notification rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, pages reach me over the channels I choose — push, SMS, phone call, and email — with per-channel notification rules

citations.quote: Notifications via push, Slack, Microsoft Teams, email
Signals offers a complete alerting solution with on-call schedules, escalation policies, and multi-platform notifications
